glosses: Of or pertaining to a person of high birth; noble; not plebeian; aristocratic.

examples.text: born in the patrician file of society

glosses: Characteristic of or appropriate to a person of high birth; classy.

glosses: Politically active to help people in lower classes, especially in a patronizing or condescending way.

examples.text: It will speed the shrivelling of the patrician “one nation” Tories, who tried to curb the extremes of Thatcherism and ended by providing its veils.

Where Ruskin's patrician socialism sought to create better conditions and 'higher' aspirations for the 'Workmen and Labourers of Great Britain', Sickert painted his working- and lower-middle-class subjects as if history, in the advance of mass culture and popular democracy, were on their side.
